evidence.detail: R48 RSApplet constructs rs/D directly and installs it as a ComponentListener on the same render/input Component that already carries the RSApplet listeners.
rs/D extends ComponentAdapter and overrides only componentMoved(ComponentEvent); it stores exactly one synthetic/reference field back to RSApplet.

componentMoved debounces against Client.j with a 100 ms threshold, sets Client.h=true when movement is accepted, and refreshes Client.j from System.currentTimeMillis(). No resize/focus/input behavior is present.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the RSApplet-owned component-movement listener. The downstream meaning of Client.h is intentionally not renamed here.
